title: The Sketchbook Page Torn Clean
youtube_title: The Sketchbook Page Torn Clean | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: What is split with care does not become less important.
summary: At a school cloakroom and the lunch mats just beyond, Delia sees that a sketchbook page torn clean along the grain will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Delia makes a smaller, even share so Willa is included, and Uncle Idris lets the choice stand without a speech.
